title: Tiger Activity Followed by Human Presence at Nearby Camera
description: A Bengal tiger is recorded at Telia Stream Crossing (CAM-02). 15 minutes later, an unauthorized person is detected at North Forest Trail (CAM-01, ~450m away), indicating heightened wildlife security concern.

events.notes: Adult tiger moving along stream bank towards North Trail.
Person detected on North Forest Trail 15 minutes after tiger crossed downstream.
